settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Choose the app language. Defaults to your in-game language.
settings.jumpToPositionHint: Each screenshot re-centers the map on you (and switches to the raid's map).
settings.jumpToPositionLabel: Jump to my position on screenshot
settings.followZoomHint: How close the camera sits when it jumps.
settings.automaticFloorsOnlyHint: Hides the floor control; the map always tracks your floor (AUTO).
settings.eftFolderUpdated: EFT folder updated. Click Sync past logs to backfill quest history.
settings.credits: Unofficial fan tool — not affiliated with Battlestate Games. Quest, map & POI data by tarkov.dev · map rendering by Leaflet (BSD-2) · icons by Phosphor (MIT).
settings.compactModeHint: Map only, window kept above other windows — for a borderless game on one monitor. Nothing can be drawn over a game in exclusive fullscreen.
settings.compactOnTopFailed: Couldn't keep the window on top; compact mode still hides the rail.
settings.hotkeysHint: They work while this window has focus and never capture keys from the game.
settings.minimapHint: A small map in its own window, kept above the game in a corner that stays clear (top-right by default), centered on you and turned to where you look. Your game must run in Borderless mode — nothing can be shown over exclusive fullscreen.
settings.minimapDesktopOnly: Available in the desktop app only.
settings.minimapOnlyInRaidHint: Appears when a raid starts and goes away when it ends (read from the game logs).
settings.minimapWaitingRaid: On: it will appear when your next raid starts.
settings.minimapLocked: Locked (clicks pass through to the game)
settings.minimapLockedHint: Unlock to drag it anywhere, then lock it again — the spot is remembered.
settings.minimapHeadingUpHint: The direction you face is always up. Off = north up.
settings.minimapLimits: Position and view direction come from your screenshots, so the minimap moves each time you take one (bind the screenshot key to a spare mouse button). Between screenshots it does not move; an old fix fades. It never reads the game's memory.

tracker.title: TarkovTracker
tracker.desktopOnly: Available in the desktop app only.
tracker.hint: Syncs quests, objectives, level and hideout with tarkovtracker.org. The key is kept in Windows Credential Manager; MoA never shows it.
tracker.noKeyHint: Opens a window: paste the key there and press Enter.
tracker.recheck: I already saved it — check again
tracker.modeNote: The key decides the game mode. Use a key of the mode you play (PvP, PvE or season).
tracker.autoPushHint: Quests finished or failed live in the game, statuses you set by hand, objective ticks and level. Old log history is not re-sent.
tracker.noWrite: This key cannot write ("write progress"); MoA only imports.
tracker.diff_one: {{count}} quest MoA knows that TarkovTracker does not
tracker.diff_other: {{count}} quests MoA knows that TarkovTracker does not
tracker.diffHint: From the game logs and your manual statuses. After a wipe these may be from the previous wipe: check before sending.
tracker.keyStored: Key saved in Windows Credential Manager

err.bad_key: The saved key has an unexpected format. Enter it again.
err.unauthorized: TarkovTracker rejected the key (revoked or wrong mode). Enter a new one.
err.forbidden: The key lacks a permission needed for this.
err.rate_limited: Daily TarkovTracker limit reached. Trying again in about {{minutes}} min.
err.unavailable: TarkovTracker is temporarily unavailable. Trying again shortly.
err.bad_request: TarkovTracker refused part of the data (a quest or objective that does not exist in this mode). It was skipped.
err.network: Could not reach TarkovTracker. Check your connection.
err.storage: Could not read Windows Credential Manager.
err.bad_format: That does not look like a TarkovTracker key: it starts with PVP_, PVE_ or SZN_.

tracker.keyFieldHint: Get it at tarkovtracker.org → Settings → API Tokens (tick "read progress" and, to send, "write progress"). It is checked with TarkovTracker before it is kept; the field empties when saved.
tracker.orWindow: I'd rather type it in a separate window

squadServer.title: Squad server (advanced)
squadServer.hint: Only to use a squad server of your own. To play with friends over Radmin VPN, use "Join party" in the Squad tab — it is automatic.
squadServer.invalid: That is not an address. Type the host's IP, e.g. 26.12.34.56.
squadServer.fail: Could not reach the server. Is the host running the party and on the same Radmin network?

settings.creditsIntro: Opening animation: glass reveal adapted from zanwei/glass-icon-reveal (MIT).

appearance.markerHint: Your party sees this symbol and colour on their map and minimap. The arrow on the ring shows where you are looking.
appearance.viewConeHint: A soft cone in front of each marker, in the direction the player faces.
appearance.mapBrightnessHint: Dim bright maps so markers and glass stand out.
appearance.layoutHint: Floating: panels float over the map as glass. Side by side: panels sit next to the map.
appearance.animationsHint: Panel transitions, pulses and the marker preview.
appearance.introHint: Plays when the app opens. Click or press any key to skip it.
appearance.placeLabelsHint: Big Red, Dorms, Scav Town… on the main map only, never on the minimap.
appearance.questNamesHint: Writes the quest's name next to each of its places.
appearance.upcomingQuestsHint: Also pins quests you can start now (prerequisites and level met) in a softer colour, not only the ones the game logged as accepted.
appearance.otherExitsHint: In a raid, exits that are not yours (the other side's, or not in the O+O list) stay faded on the map and the minimap. Off: they are hidden.
appearance.sniperRangeHint: Radius of the 360° red ring around each Scav sniper. An average of how far they hit; adjust if you like.
appearance.sniperConeHint: Also shows where the sniper probably aims, estimated from the exits, loot and spawns around it. An estimate: the game does not tell where it aims.

errors.squadServerOffline: Couldn't reach the squad server — it may be offline. Check your connection and try again.
errors.squadUnreachable: Couldn't reach the squad. Double-check the code and your connection, then try again.

squad.name: Name
squad.sharedHint: Two or more of you have these active — their pins pulse on the map. Push together.

party.hint: On Radmin VPN or the same home network: if someone is already in a party you join it; if not, you host and the next players join you. No code.
party.radminOff: Turn on Radmin VPN, or connect the PCs to the same router, for the automatic party.
party.title: Radmin party
party.noRadmin: Radmin VPN is not on. Turn it on, join your friends’ network and try again.
party.portBusy: Another program is using the party port (8787). Close it and try again.
party.failed: Could not start the party. Try again.
party.firewallDeclined: The firewall permission was not given: friends may not be able to join you. Leave and join the party again to see the prompt.
party.byIp: Or join by your friend's IP
party.byIpHint: Ask the friend hosting for the IP shown on their screen (Radmin 26.x or home network 192.168.x).
party.notAtIp: No party answered at {{ip}}. Your friend must have the party open in MoA, and the first time they host, Windows asks to allow it in the firewall.
party.noNetwork: No network found. Turn on Radmin VPN (friends far away) or connect the PC to the router (same house).
party.lanPublic: Windows marks the home network as Public and Radmin is off. Turn Radmin on, or mark the network as Private in Windows network settings.

squad.mirrored: This is the game PC's party, shown here because this PC is linked to it. To leave, leave on the game PC.

art.calHint: The first time you click where 4 exits are on this picture; after that every marker is drawn on it.

position.subtitle2: to a comfortable key in the game's settings — we recommend
position.subtitle3: — and tap it in raid whenever you want your arrow to move.
position.jumpToPositionDesc: Each screenshot switches to the raid's map and centers on you.
position.jumpToPositionLabel: Jump to my position on screenshot
position.followZoomDesc: How close the camera sits when it jumps.

ready.title: You're set. The rail runs everything:

planner.loadError: Couldn't load progression data. The planner relies on the data snapshot shipped with the app — restart, and reinstall if it persists.

planner.sourceBundled: Quest, hideout and price data: tarkov.dev snapshot from {{date}} (shipped with this version).

profile.title: Your profile
profile.hint: The game doesn't write your level or faction to any file the app can read. Enter them to see what you can take right now; while unknown, nothing is hidden.

summary.trackingNote: Only Side quests are tracked from the logs. Mark anything else by hand in Quests — manual marks are labelled and always reversible.
summary.staleActive: {{count}} quest(s) still look active in the logs, but a later quest you took proves they are done.
summary.nextHint: Available quests ranked by how many quests they unlock later (Kappa breaks ties). A heuristic, not advice from the game.
summary.noSuggestions: Nothing available right now with what the app knows.

quests.objectivesManual: Objective ticks are yours: the logs only report whole quests.
quests.traderUnknown: (loyalty isn't readable from the logs — not checked)
quests.availableNote: “Available” means no unmet prerequisite in tarkov.dev's data. Some quests are also gated in game by trader loyalty or by events the data does not encode — check the trader if one is missing.

items.summary: {{count}} items still needed, {{fir}} found in raid.
items.counterNote: Counters are your own tally — the app can't see your stash.
items.empty: Nothing left to collect for this selection.

hideout.hint: Set each station's built level — the game doesn't expose it. Open a station to see what its next level needs.
hideout.unknownReqs: Trader loyalty and skills aren't readable — check them in game.

raid.pickMap: Pick a map to plan a raid.
raid.noKeys: No keys required by your active quests here.
raid.noCarry: Nothing to plant, mark or use for your active quests here.
raid.noGatedExtracts: No extract here needs a switch, an item or a payment.
raid.firWanted: Keep an eye out (found in raid)
raid.noFir: No found-in-raid hand-ins pending for active quests.
raid.nothingSpecial: Nothing special to bring — just your kit.
raid.squadNote: Derived from the quests each teammate shares — the same data your own list uses.

stats.title: Raid history
stats.empty: No raids recorded yet. Play a raid, or run “Sync past logs”.
stats.limits: From the logs: map and start/end time only. Survival, kills, loot and XP aren't in any file the app can read, so they aren't shown.

market.noPrices: No price data in this build.
market.estimate: Estimates from a price snapshot taken {{date}}. Flea prices move constantly; fees and trader loyalty aren't included.
market.craftNote: Cost = cheaper of flea average or trader offer; value = better of flea average or trader buy-back. Tools come back and aren't counted.

side.scavNow: This raid: Scav — showing Scav extracts
side.unknownNow: Current raid: not sure yet whether PMC or Scav — exits faded until you screenshot O+O or mark it below
side.scavQuests: On a Scav run most PMC quests do not progress.

extractPanel.read_one: Read {{count}} exit from the O+O screenshot
extractPanel.read_other: Read {{count}} exits from the O+O screenshot — the map now shows only those
extractPanel.notMatched: Could not match the O+O list to this map’s exits. Is the right map selected?
extractPanel.hint: Press O twice in raid and take a screenshot with the list open: MoA reads your exits from it.
extractPanel.readSwitched_one: Read {{count}} exit from the O+O screenshot — switched to {{map}}
extractPanel.readSwitched_other: Read {{count}} exits from the O+O screenshot — switched to {{map}}, showing only those
extractPanel.missingOcrLanguage: Windows cannot read text in the game’s language ({{lang}}). Add that language in Windows Settings → Time & language → Language, then try again.
extractPanel.provedScav: From the list: you are a Scav (the app will remember).
extractPanel.provedPmc: From the list: you are a PMC (the app will remember).

raidPill.fix: Wrong side? Click to switch PMC / Scav (remembered for this profile)
raidPill.leftHint: Time left in the raid (PMC: from the raid's start and the map's length)
raidPill.elapsedHint: Time in the raid (a Scav joins with less time, which the game does not tell)

gunsmith.codeCopied: Preset code copied. Paste it to a friend.
gunsmith.badCode: That isn't a MoA preset code.
gunsmith.noPresets: No presets yet. Build a gun and press Save preset.

main.title: This is the game PC
main.allow: Let my other PCs show this game
main.allowHint: Turn this on on the PC you play on. The other PC shows the map, your position, the exits and the quests as if it were another monitor of this one.
main.thisPc: This PC's name on the network: {{name}}
main.firewallOff: The firewall was not opened: the other PC may not reach this one. Use Test connection → Open firewall.
main.none: No PC linked yet. On the other PC, open this tab and click Find my PCs.
main.autoAccept: Accept my home-network PCs on their own
main.autoAcceptHint: A PC on the same router links without a question. Over Radmin (a network with other people) it still asks the first time.

screen.title: This PC is the extra screen
screen.hint: On the PC that only shows the map: find the game PC and link. The game PC must have MoA open with the option above on.
screen.noneFound: No PC found. On the game PC, turn on "Let my other PCs show this game" and search again, or type its IP below.
screen.byIp: Or by the game PC's IP
screen.confirm: Confirm on the game PC ({{host}}). The code there should be:

state.linked: Linked to {{name}}: this PC shows the game from there.
state.lost: The connection to {{name}} dropped. Retrying on its own…

screen.refused: The game PC did not allow it (or removed this PC). Search again to ask once more.
screen.partyNote: On the extra screen the party works to see your friends, but it does not send a position: the game PC does.

request.title: Link a PC?
request.body: {{name}} ({{ip}}) wants to show this PC's game: map, position, exits and quests.
request.check: Only allow it if it is yours. Check that the code on its screen is:

error.port_busy: Another program is using port 8789. Close it and try again.
error.bad_ip: Invalid IP: use the Radmin one (26.x) or the home network one (192.168.x).
error.other: That did not work. Use Test connection below to see why.

mode.title: This PC
mode.detecting: Checking whether this PC has Tarkov…
mode.isGame: Now: game PC — your other PCs link to it on their own.
mode.isScreen: Now: extra screen — looks for the game PC on the network and links on its own.
mode.isOff: Off: this PC does not link to any other.

test.title: Test connection
test.hint: Checks, step by step, everything a connection between two PCs needs. To test up to a specific PC, type its IP.

radmin.info: Radmin VPN off (only needed to play with friends far away)

lan.info: This PC is not on a home network

noNetwork.help: Turn on Radmin VPN or connect the PC to the router and test again.

lanPublic.warn: Windows marks the home network ({{ip}}) as Public
lanPublic.help: A linked PC works anyway. Only the party over the home network is off; to allow it, in Windows Settings → Network & Internet → network properties, choose Private.

firewall.warn: The firewall is not open for MoA yet
firewall.help: Without it, other PCs may not reach this one. Click Open firewall and accept the Windows prompt.

partyPort.fail: The party port ({{port}}) is taken by another program
partyPort.help: Close the program using that port and test again.

linkPort.fail: The linked-PC port ({{port}}) is taken by another program
linkPort.help: Close the program using that port and test again.

partyFound.info: No party open on the network right now

linkFound.info: No PC accepting links on the network right now

target.ok: {{ip}} is on a network of this PC
target.warn: {{ip}} is not on a network of this PC
target.fail: {{ip}} is neither a Radmin nor a home-network IP
target.help: Check the IP. Both PCs must be on the same Radmin or the same router.

targetParty.warn: That PC answers, but the party connection does not open
targetParty.info: That PC is not hosting a party right now
targetParty.help: Its firewall is probably blocking. On the other PC, run this test and click Open firewall.

targetLink.ok: Link with that PC works ({{ms}} ms round trip)
targetLink.warn: That PC's port opens, but it does not answer
targetLink.info: That PC is not accepting links right now
targetLink.help: Update MoA on both PCs and test again.

crashed.help: Close and reopen MoA and try again.
